items.action: trim CLAUDE.md, move rarely-used rules to skills, disable unused MCP servers and plugins
items.explain: The fixed prefix (system prompt, CLAUDE.md, tool schemas, skills, plugins) is sent on every request. Even as a cache read it is billed on every call, so its cost per turn is prefix × cache-read price × calls per turn. Trim CLAUDE.md, move rarely used rules into skills, and disable MCP servers and plugins you do not use in this project.
items.headline: Fixed prefix 49k tokens ≈$0.15/turn at 15 calls

items.action: queue: 'run builds and test suites longer than a minute in the background'
items.action_text: Run builds and test suites longer than a minute in the background and keep working meanwhile.
items.evidence: a foreground Bash call longer than a minute; Claude waited for it
items.explain: A foreground Bash call blocks the turn until it exits. For builds and test suites that take more than a minute, run them in the background (`run_in_background`): Claude keeps working and is notified when the command finishes. Calls Claude Code backgrounded itself do not count.
